title: The Kariakoo Restaurant Said Salim Bakhresa Bought in 1975
conflicts: Workforce and turnover figures disagree widely across Wikipedia, the group's board page and Daily News, so none is used. The Citizen gives his age as 78 in January 2026, Wikipedia a 1949 birth year; no birth year given. The first-mill date (1992) comes only from Bühler and is attributed to it. Funding changed from the slate's 'bootstrapped' to 'unknown' because no source says how the 1975 purchase was paid for.
notes: Bakhresa rarely speaks publicly; the founder voice rests on one interview (UTV Fahari Yetu, 30 January 2026) as translated by The Citizen. Several supporting sources are the group's own pages; Daily News and Food Business Africa are the independent press. Quote stance: complicates (Aristotle on needing relaxation set against his months without leisure).
